clue.text: Map army can carry round to find area with trees, say

parts.note: to map out is to plan
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's reserve force

indicators.note: the can carries the round letter inside it, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: a can is a tin
a round shape looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: A soldier hauls a tin of maps round to locate a wood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carry round' reads as one phrase, but 'carry' is the container signal and 'round' gives O, so TIN holds O to make TION.
explanation.definitionFit: A plantation is an estate planted with crops, trees being one example, hence 'say'.

clue.text: One dipping into bowl, famous hand-washer

indicators.note: the single letter goes down inside the dish, so one piece sits within another

parts.note: a plate is a shallow dish, loosely a bowl
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Someone dips into a bowl, like the famous figure who washed his hands.
explanation.walkthrough: Pontius Pilate washed his hands to disclaim responsibility for the condemnation of Jesus.
explanation.definitionFit: Pontius Pilate is famed for publicly washing his hands of Christ's fate.

clue.text: Yet to be on the losing end, like the proverbially spoilt child?

definitions.text: Yet to be on the losing end
definitions.meaning: never having lost a game or contest
'spare the rod and spoil the child': the spoilt child was never thrashed

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both never defeated in competition and never given a thrashing, as the proverb says.

clue.text: Snapshot taken with night starting? There's minimal light

parts.note: a snapshot is a photo

indicators.note: only the starting letter of night is wanted here

explanation.surface: A picture taken as night begins has hardly any light in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A photon is a single quantum of light, the smallest amount there can be.

clue.text: Small container with plant brought into class

indicators.note: the plant word is carried inside the class word, so one sits within the other

parts.note: a caste is a social class
to set is to plant, as seedlings are set out

explanation.surface: A little pot with a plant in it is carried into the classroom.
explanation.definitionFit: A cassette is a small case or cartridge holding tape or film.

clue.text: TV series? One may get into a lather

definitions.meaning: a ... opera is a long-running television drama

definitions.text: One may get into a lather
definitions.meaning: a bar of washing material foams up into lather

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a serial drama on television and the bar used for washing that lathers.

clue.text: Greek character left with wild animal — a feature of window design

parts.note: mu is the twelfth letter of the Greek alphabet
a lion is a wild animal

explanation.surface: A Greek with a lion in tow becomes an architectural detail.
explanation.definitionFit: A mullion is the vertical bar dividing the panes or lights of a window.

clue.text: Decoration rendering sir mystical or weird

indicators.note: weird suggests the letters of these three words are strangely jumbled

explanation.surface: A medal turns a knight mystical or eccentric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'weird' rearranges SIR MYSTICAL OR; 'rendering' just links. The Military Cross is a British gallantry award for army officers.
explanation.definitionFit: The Military Cross is a British gallantry medal, and medals are decorations.

clue.text: Listen attentively to the man facing a defeat

parts.note: he is the pronoun for the man
a rout is a crushing defeat

explanation.surface: Pay close attention to the fellow who is facing a heavy loss.
explanation.definitionFit: To hear someone out is to let them finish speaking and listen fully.

clue.text: A safe right inside France's very fashionable financial office

indicators.note: these pieces go inside the French word, which wraps round them

parts.note: tres is French for very
safe can mean sure, as in a safe bet
hip means fashionable

explanation.surface: A strongbox inside a French chic office keeps the money safe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'safe' looks like a strongbox but means sure, as in a safe bet; 'inside' places the three opening pieces within the French word.
explanation.definitionFit: The post of a treasurer, the officer in charge of an organisation's funds, is a financial office.

clue.text: Feature that could be made of tin and enamel

indicators.note: suggests the answer's letters could be rearranged out of these two words

explanation.surface: A fitting that might be manufactured from tin and enamel.
explanation.walkthrough: TIN and ENAMEL together are rearranged; 'and' only joins them.
explanation.definitionFit: Lineaments are distinctive features, especially of a face.

clue.text: Austrian composer drank endlessly

indicators.note: the word for drank loses its final letter, having no end

parts.note: supped means drank

explanation.surface: An Austrian composer who drank without stopping.
explanation.walkthrough: Franz von Suppé was a 19th-century Austrian composer of light operas such as Poet and Peasant.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz von Suppé was a composer born in the Austrian Empire, famous for operettas and overtures.

clue.text: The sporting event — he's left a footprint

indicators.note: left means departed, so the pronoun is taken away from the first word

parts.note: taken as written
he's here reads as 'he has', naming the letters to remove
a race is a sporting event

explanation.surface: After the race, a man has gone and left a footprint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'he's left' reads as 'he has left': the man departs from the first word, leaving only T.
explanation.definitionFit: A trace is a mark or sign left behind, as a footprint is.

clue.text: Alcoholic medicines with colours? 'Cures with tint' possibly

indicators.note: possibly says the quoted words might rearrange into the answer

explanation.surface: Drug-laced medicines that come coloured might be called cures with tint.
explanation.walkthrough: CURES and TINT are rearranged; 'with' only joins them. In heraldry the colours are also called by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: Tinctures are medicines dissolved in alcohol, and in heraldry the word also covers colours.

clue.text: Article blocking dirt road somehow gets one slowing down gradually

indicators.note: the article sits in the middle of the jumbled road, blocking it
somehow means the letters of the two words are mixed up

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Something blocking a muddy track makes traffic gradually slow down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' scrambles the two words into RITARDDO, and 'blocking' sets the article in the middle. The answer is a musical direction.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a ritardando is a passage marked to slow down gradually.

clue.text: Checks what sounds like downpour, something wrong

indicators.note: the next word is said aloud and spelt as a word with the same sound

parts.note: a downpour is heavy rain
a sin is something wrong

explanation.surface: Inspects a heavy shower, which seems to be a bad thing.
explanation.definitionFit: To rein in is to restrain or check, as a rider does with a horse.

clue.text: The French, beset by environment not good, get comfortably ensconced

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded, so the French article sits inside
not tells us to drop the letter for good from the word for environment

parts.note: a setting is an environment or surroundings
le is French for the

explanation.surface: French people surrounded by a poor setting still manage to make themselves at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not' drops G from the environment word, leaving SETTIN; 'beset by' wraps that round the French article.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle in is to become comfortable in a new home or situation.

clue.text: City churches terrible? Not all

indicators.note: Not all says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Are a town's churches awful? Not every one.
explanation.definitionFit: Chester is a historic cathedral city in Cheshire, north-west England.

clue.text: My career is running part of the dairy industry

indicators.note: running suggests the letters are on the move into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone says their working life is spent running a farm.
explanation.definitionFit: A creamery is a factory where butter and cheese are made from milk.

clue.text: Officer studies systematic layout of information

parts.note: to con is to study or learn by heart
a table sets data out in rows and columns

explanation.surface: An official pores over a chart of data.
explanation.definitionFit: A constable is a police officer of the lowest rank.

clue.text: To experience a hug is contemplated

definitions.meaning: to be clasped in someone's arms, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it means being embraced; as one it means gazed upon or observed.

clue.text: Attendant to rush with expenditure of energy

indicators.note: spending the energy letter means it is used up and removed

parts.note: to career is to rush headlong
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A helper hurries about, using up all their energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A carer is someone who looks after a sick or elderly person, an attendant.

clue.text: Church for our lot won't have female singers

indicators.note: won't have tells us to drop the female letter from the little word beside it

parts.note: our lot means us

explanation.surface: A church decides its choir will have no women singers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'won't have' drops F to leave OR. The surface suggests a men-only choir; 'female' only supplies the letter dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: A chorus is a body of singers performing together.

clue.text: There's no yen in Irish county for some of butcher's stuff

indicators.note: says the letter for the yen is missing from the county name

parts.note: Offaly is a county in the Irish midlands
Y is the abbreviation for yen, the Japanese currency

explanation.surface: In an Irish county nobody wants some of what the butcher sells.
explanation.definitionFit: Offal is the edible innards of an animal, such as liver and kidneys, sold by butchers.

clue.text: Order one to eat unhealthy food? Quite the opposite!

indicators.note: eating means one piece goes inside another
this reverses the roles, so the food swallows the numeral rather than the other way round

parts.note: fat is unhealthy food
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Instructing someone to eat junk food? Actually, no.
explanation.walkthrough: Read plainly, I would eat FAT; 'Quite the opposite!' makes FAT take in I instead.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiat is an authoritative decree or order.

clue.text: One offers alternative treatment in way that includes love

indicators.note: the two words together take the love letter inside them

parts.note: home means in, as in 'not at home'
a path is a way
love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

explanation.surface: A therapist works in a manner full of affection.
explanation.walkthrough: HOME (in) and PATH (way) together hold O at their join.
explanation.definitionFit: A homeopath practises homeopathy, a form of alternative medicine.

clue.text: Tell the tale about a new dog

indicators.note: the patter word goes about the other letters, enclosing them

parts.note: a spiel is a glib sales patter, a tale told

explanation.surface: Spin a yarn about a new puppy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tell the tale' is a British idiom for spinning a plausible story; SPIEL holds A and N.
explanation.definitionFit: A spaniel is a breed of dog with long drooping ears.

clue.text: Assembling to have several drinks at Oxford?

parts.note: a round is a set of drinks bought for a group
to be up is to be at university, such as Oxford

explanation.surface: Gathering to stand drinks for friends while studying at Oxford.
explanation.definitionFit: A round-up is a gathering together, as of cattle or of people.
